question_text: Write the summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Sher-E-Bangla is one of the greatest leaders of Bangladesh. He brought about a revolutionary change in the political scenario of Bangladesh. He was the General Secretary of Indian Congress. He was the President of All India Muslim League. He was the Chief Minister of Bengal. As a Education Minister, he established many educational institutions. He was the first elected Prime Minister of Bengal. His leadership qualities were much impressive. We remember him with gratitude.

He was the General Secretary of Indian Congress. He was the president of All India Muslim League. He was the Chief Minister of Bengal. As an Education Minister he established many educational institutions. He was the first elected Prime Minister of Bengal. His leadership qualities were very much impressive. We remember him with gratitude.
